language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the customer text, or und when it cannot be determined

spam_probability.description: Probability that the text is spam or a scam, 0 to 1

abuse_type.description: The most serious kind of inappropriate content in the text, or none

abuse_score.description: How clearly the text contains abuse_type, 0 to 1; 0 when abuse_type is none

has_substance.description: The text contains a factual objection, question or opinion about the product, service or business

reason.description: One short English sentence, without quoting personal data

knowledge_required.description: Knowledge keys from the provided list needed for a reply
